data.long_meaning: A beautiful Islamic name with deep spiritual significance. The name Khalfan carries the meaning “Noble and blessed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khalfan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
